description: The plot illustrates how the number of “Shared Experts for Two Samples” varies with “Sample Token Count” for six task categories shown as separate colored lines. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a logarithmic base-2 style tick labeling from approximately \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\), with ticks at each integer exponent. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples” and appears linear, spanning roughly from 2.0 up to about 6.2 with labeled ticks at 0.5 increments (e.g., 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, …, 6.0). The Intent series is an orange solid line that starts near about 3.9 at \(2^9\), rises to around the mid–4s by \(2^{10}\), shows a dip around \(2^{11}\) (near ~4.3), then increases through the 5–6 range and approaches about 6.2 by the highest token counts. The Summary series is a blue solid line that begins near 2.0 at \(2^9\), jumps to about 5.0 by \(2^{10}\), stays near ~5.0 around \(2^{11}\), then climbs steadily above 5.5 and reaches roughly 6.2 near the right end. The Law series is a yellow/gold solid line that starts around 3.7 at \(2^9\), increases to about 5.0 by \(2^{10}\), fluctuates slightly around the low-to-mid 5s near \(2^{11}\)–\(2^{12}\), and then rises toward approximately 6.2 at larger token counts. The Translation series is a purple solid line that begins around 5.2 at \(2^9\), peaks near ~5.5 around \(2^{10}\), dips slightly near \(2^{11}\) (around ~5.1), then increases through the upper 5s and reaches about 6.2 toward the maximum token counts. The Code series is a gray solid line that starts near 2.0 at \(2^9\), increases gradually to the low 3s by about \(2^{11}\), rises into the 4s around \(2^{12}\)–\(2^{13}\) with a visible dip near \(2^{14}\) (around ~4.0), then climbs sharply into the mid-to-high 5s by about \(2^{15}\)–\(2^{16}\) and approaches roughly 6.2 near the right end. The Math series is a green solid line that starts near 3.9 at \(2^9\), increases to about 5.0 by \(2^{10}\), continues upward through the mid-to-high 5s across \(2^{11}\)–\(2^{14}\), and reaches approximately 6.2 at the largest token counts.
